data.name: tip_ct_preset
data.value: Quick settings for the compression level and CPU cores. Changing either value selects the matching preset, or Custom.

data.name: tip_ct_level
data.value: zlib level for each block: 1 is the fastest, 9 gives the smallest image, 0 stores the blocks uncompressed. The default is 7.

data.name: tip_ct_cpu
data.value: How many CPU cores compress blocks at the same time. Auto uses every core of this computer; choose fewer to keep the computer responsive or to use less memory.

data.name: tip_ct_block
data.value: Size of the blocks the image is split into and compressed one by one. PS5 games use 64 KiB; change it only if you know the target needs another size.

data.name: tip_ct_threshold
data.value: A compressed block is kept only if it saves at least this percentage; otherwise it is stored uncompressed. 0 keeps every block that gets smaller.

data.name: tip_ct_max_ratio
data.value: A file stays uncompressed when its compressed size would be above this percentage of the original. 100 compresses every file that gets smaller.

data.name: tip_ct_min_size
data.value: Files smaller than this many bytes are stored uncompressed without trying. Empty uses the block size.

data.name: tip_adv_signed
data.value: Build a signed PFS image, using a zero EKPFS key and seed.

data.name: tip_adv_dry
data.value: Check the source and show what would be written, without writing the image.

data.name: tip_adv_verify
data.value: After packing, decode the whole image and compare it with the source. Slower, but proves the image is correct.

data.name: tip_adv_skip_check
data.value: Skip the quick structure check that runs after packing.

data.name: tip_adv_keep_ext
data.value: Use the output file name exactly as typed. Otherwise the extension is changed to match the format (.ffpfsc or .ffpfs).

data.name: tip_adv_keep_inner
data.value: Keep the source file's name inside the image. Otherwise it is renamed to a safe, normalized name.

data.name: tip_adv_spool
data.value: Build through a temporary staging file instead of writing straight into the image. Slower; use it only if the default way fails.

data.name: tip_adv_version
data.value: PFS format profile: PS5 for PS5 games, PS4 for PS4 images.

data.name: tip_adv_inode
data.value: Width of the inode entries: 32-bit, the default, or 64-bit.

data.name: tip_adv_case
data.value: Make file names inside the image case-sensitive. By default they are not.

data.name: tip_adv_verbose
data.value: Write more detail to the log.

data.name: tip_adv_encrypted
data.value: Encrypt the image blocks with AES-XTS.

data.name: tip_adv_new_crypt
data.value: Derive the encryption keys with the alternate newCrypt method.

data.name: tip_adv_ekpfs
data.value: 64 hexadecimal characters: the EKPFS key for encrypting or signing. Empty uses all zeros.

data.name: tip_adv_cluster
data.value: exFAT cluster size. Auto (64 KiB) works best with ShadowMountPlus; smaller clusters waste less space on small files but read slower.

data.name: tip_adv_image_format
data.value: How to read the image: Auto detects PFS or exFAT; choose one to force it.

data.name: tip_v_require
data.value: Warn when sce_sys/param.json, eboot.bin or pfs-version.dat is missing from the game.
